timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Nvidia, a leader in artificial intelligence, has released guardrails, a universal system designed to keep AI in check.
This new system is designed to help ensure that AI behaves responsibly and ethically while still allowing it to learn and grow.
This open source system is a great way to ensure that we are able to keep our AI in line and trust that we are in control.
So, let's welcome our new AI overlords and trust that. Nvidia's guardrails has our back.
